title: Coal Launcher
description: Adds a weapon that shoots burning coals at things
body:
This mod adds burning coals and a coal launcher.

Burning coals:
Burning coals can be used as ammunition for the coal launcher. An impact, burning coals set entities on fire and do a small amount of damage. In addition, burning coals can be used to smelt 12 items in a furnace.
Burning coals can be obtained by smelting coal in a furnace or on a campfire.
9 Burning coals can also be crafted into magma blocks.

Coal launcher:
The coal launcher is a short ranged projectile weapon used to shoot burning coals at enemies and set them on fire. It can be crafted with 1 iron bar, 3 iron ingots, and an iron nugget.
